billing_001.question: Where can I see my invoices?
billing_001.answer: You can access all your invoices from your account dashboard. Go to Settings > Billing > Invoices. You'll see a complete history of all charges with PDF download options.

billing_002.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
billing_002.answer: To cancel your subscription, navigate to Settings > Subscription > Manage Subscription, then click 'Cancel Subscription'. Your service will continue until the end of your current billing period.

billing_003.question: I was charged incorrectly, can I get a refund?
billing_003.answer: We apologize for the billing error. Please contact our billing support with details of the incorrect charge, and we'll investigate immediately. Refunds for billing errors are typically processed within 3-5 business days.

billing_004.question: How do I upgrade my plan?
billing_004.answer: You can upgrade your plan anytime from Settings > Subscription > Upgrade Plan. You'll see all available plans with feature comparisons. Upgrade charges are prorated based on your current billing cycle.

billing_005.question: How do I update my payment method?
billing_005.answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Payment Methods to update your payment information. You can add, update, or remove payment methods at any time. Changes take effect immediately.

billing_006.question: Can I apply a discount or coupon code?
billing_006.answer: Yes! Go to Settings > Billing > Billing Details and enter your coupon code in 'Apply Coupon'. The discount will be applied to your next billing cycle within 24 hours.
